title: EFD Unit 5 · Part 3 · The Order Is Ready

text.en: Welcome to English for Furniture Designers. This is Unit 5, Making a Piece: Steps and Process.
text.ar: أهلاً بكم في الإنجليزية لمصمّمي الأثاث. هذه الوحدة الخامسة، صناعة القطعة: الخطوات والعمليّة.

text.en: This is Part 3, The Order Is Ready. You will hear a finished sofa described in the past passive.
text.ar: هذا الجزء الثالث، الطلبيّة جاهزة. ستسمع وصف كنبة جاهزة بالمجهول الماضي.

text.en: What does a manager tell a customer when the sofa is ready?
text.ar: ماذا تقول المديرة للزبون حين تجهز الكنبة؟

text.en: Good morning, Mr Haddad. Your sofa is ready.
text.ar: صباح الخير سيّد حدّاد. كنبتك جاهزة.

text.en: Wonderful! How was it made?
First, it was designed by Layla.
Then the oak frame was cut and assembled.
After that, it was upholstered with soft grey fabric.
text.ar: بعد ذلك، نُجِّدت بقماش رماديّ ناعم.

text.en: Next, it was varnished and cleaned.
Finally, it was checked by our quality team.
When can it be delivered?
It can be delivered tomorrow morning.
Perfect. Thank you.
Now put the steps in order. The first is done.
It was designed by Layla. That is step one.
Which step is second?
The oak frame was cut and assembled.
Which step is third?
It was upholstered with fabric.
Which step is fourth?
It was checked by the quality team.
Notice: was, not is.
The sofa is finished, so the steps are in the past.
text.ar: الكنبة انتهت، لذا الخطوات في الماضي.

text.en: Same passive, different time.
